verdict.rationale: The professional portal links to its own tutorials ("Découvrir les tutoriels"), a practical guide for the e-invoicing reform, and plain-language FAQ entries such as how to access and pay a CFE notice or the benefits of direct debit. So first-party, non-statute guidance for founder tasks exists, but the evidence shows only headings and snippets, not the depth or step-by-step quality of that content. Missing for 10: evidence of actual step-by-step walkthrough content, coverage across core founder tasks (company creation, VAT registration, first filings), and independent or hands-on confirmation that non-lawyers can follow the guidance.
